Sync across devices
Background photos

The 12 built-in photos come from Unsplash and are saved inside the planner, so they work without internet. Your own photos are shrunk to screen size and kept in this browser; backups do not include them.

Backup and data

Everything you enter is saved in this browser on this device. Copy a backup now and then, and use it to move your data to another browser or computer.
